title: Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal Prototype Optimization for Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.30726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) is a fundamental component of affective computing that aims to decipher complex emotional states by integrating verbal content with non-verbal cues including vocal intonation and facial micro-expressions. While recent disentanglement-based approaches have advanced the field, their potential is hindered by two methodological challenges. First, static computation graphs process all samples indiscriminately regardless of semantic complexity, which leads to suboptimal representation for diverse emotional expressions and contextual scenarios. Second, generic contrastive objectives often neglect the intrinsic ordinal hierarchy of sentiment intensities. To systematically address these limitations, we introduce Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal prototype optimization (MAESTRO), a novel framework designed to dynamically orchestrate and refine multimodal representations. translated_title: 多模态自适应专家选择：面向情感分析的文本路由与序数原型优化
translated_abstract: 多模态情感分析（MSA）是情感计算的基本组成部分，旨在通过整合语言内容与语音语调、面部微表情等非语言线索来解读复杂的情感状态。尽管近年来基于解耦的方法推动了该领域的发展，但其潜力受到两个方法论挑战的制约。首先，静态计算图对所有样本不加区分地进行处理，而不考虑语义复杂度，这导致对多样化情感表达和上下文场景的表示不够理想。其次，通用的对比目标往往忽略了情感强度固有的序数层级关系。为了系统地解决这些局限性，我们提出了多模态自适应专家选择与文本路由及序数原型优化框架（MAESTRO），这是一个旨在动态编排和优化多模态表示的新颖框架。
tldr: 提出了MAESTRO框架，通过基于文本路由的自适应专家选择机制动态编排多模态表示，并利用序数原型优化建模情感强度的固有层级关系，从而提升多模态情感分析的性能。
